products.name: MarketMuse
products.note: Content strategy AI; topic modeling; site-wide content audit; competitive intelligence

profile_text.body:
MarketMuse is a software company that provides AI-powered content planning and optimization tools. Its platform is designed to help users determine what content to write and in what depth, with the goal of ranking in areas where competitors are weaker. The company describes itself as having used AI in its product for over ten years, and its approach involves fetching hundreds to thousands of pages of content for each page and topic analyzed, removing low-quality outliers, and applying a combination of proprietary and open-source algorithms to classify parts of speech and calculate relevance.

The core product, also called MarketMuse, falls within the writing and editing category and encompasses topic modeling, site-wide content audits, and competitive intelligence. The company states its patented AI automatically analyzes a user's entire content inventory, identifies high-value topic clusters, and surfaces quick wins based on existing authority. Its Optimize application includes a generative AI component to accelerate content creation, though the company notes it does not write content for customers directly. Cluster analyses and content plans that would otherwise require dozens of hours of manual work are described as being produced in minutes through the platform.

No litigation, SEC filings, or MCP server registrations appear in the held facts for MarketMuse.
